questions.stem: If a table has 1,000,000 rows and a full table scan takes 0.1 ms per row, how long will the scan take in total? Give your answer in milliseconds.
questions.explanation: A full table scan reads every row. With 1,000,000 rows at 0.1 ms per row, the total time is 1,000,000 * 0.1 ms = 100,000 ms.
